why: Each folded card has a left and a right panel with three shadings: vertical lines, lines along the panel edge, and slanting (/) lines. Every row uses the same three cards in a new order: (vertical | edge-lines), (slant | vertical), (edge-lines | slant). Row 3 already has (slant | vertical) and (edge-lines | slant), so the missing card is vertical on the left and edge-lines on the right: option 5. Option 1 has the same two shadings but swapped, so it is wrong.
trick: When each row holds the same three designs, find which one is missing - and check left/right sides, not just the shading types.
